#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""Prove lossless tanh pack: audio bit-identical to pre-pack tip; table bits exact."""
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
BASE = "092589b84fd455355216cb0de93c4782236f7524"  # nightly tip before this pack


def f32(x):
    return struct.unpack("<f", struct.pack("<f", x))[0]


def bits32(x):
    return struct.unpack("<I", struct.pack("<f", x))[0]


def run(args, **kw):
    return subprocess.run(args, check=True, cwd=ROOT, **kw)


def old(path):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", BASE + ":" + path], cwd=ROOT)


def main():
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))
    import gen_drum_samples as gen  # noqa: E402

    tab = [f32(math.tanh(gen.TANH_MAX * i / gen.TANH_N)) for i in range(gen.TANH_N + 2)]
    runs, words, raw_b, packed_b = gen.pack_tanh_runs(tab)
    save_b = raw_b - packed_b
    if save_b < 600:
        print(json.dumps({"status": "NO_PR_SAVE_BELOW_FLOOR", "raw_b": raw_b,
                          "packed_b": packed_b, "save_b": save_b}))
        return 2

    ends = [end for *_, end in runs]

    def value(i):
        r = start = 0
        while i >= ends[r]:
            start = ends[r]
            r += 1
        base, offset, width, _end = runs[r]
        if width == 0:
            return base
        bit = (i - start) * width
        shift = bit & 31
        p = offset + (bit >> 5)
        v = words[p] >> shift
        if shift:
            v |= words[p + 1] << (32 - shift)
        return base | (v & ((1 << width) - 1))

    for i, want in enumerate(tab):
        got = value(i)
        if got != bits32(want):
            print(f"python reconstruct fail i={i} want={bits32(want):08x} got={got:08x}",
                  file=sys.stderr)
            return 1

    cc = os.environ.get("CC", "cc")
    dsp_dir = ROOT / "firmware" / "src" / "dsp"
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        tmp = Path(tmp)
        results = {}
        for kind in ("baseline", "packed"):
            out = tmp / kind
            gen = out / "gen"
            shadow = out / "shadow" / "dsp"
            gen.mkdir(parents=True)
            shadow.mkdir(parents=True)
            # Full DSP header shadow so quoted includes and dsp/*.h harness paths
            # both see the kind-specific drum909_dsp.h / generated tables.
            for hdr in dsp_dir.glob("*.h"):
                (shadow / hdr.name).write_bytes(hdr.read_bytes())
            dsp_path = "firmware/src/dsp/drum909_dsp.h"
            (shadow / "drum909_dsp.h").write_bytes(
                old(dsp_path) if kind == "baseline" else (ROOT / dsp_path).read_bytes())

            script = ROOT / "tools/gen_drum_samples.py"
            code = old("tools/gen_drum_samples.py") if kind == "baseline" else script.read_bytes()
            ns = {"__file__": str(script), "__name__": "generator_test"}
            exec(compile(code, str(script), "exec"), ns)
            argv = sys.argv[:]
            sys.argv = [str(script), str(gen / "x0x_drum_samples.h")]
            ns["main"]()
            sys.argv = argv
            # Tables live next to DSP headers for #include "x0x_drum_tables.h".
            (shadow / "x0x_drum_tables.h").write_bytes((gen / "x0x_drum_tables.h").read_bytes())
            (shadow / "x0x_drum_samples.h").write_bytes((gen / "x0x_drum_samples.h").read_bytes())

            objects = []
            for name in ("drum909", "fxbus"):
                path = "firmware/src/dsp/" + name + ".c"
                src = out / (name + ".c")
                src.write_bytes((ROOT / path).read_bytes())
                obj = out / (name + ".o")
                run([cc, "-O2", "-ffp-contract=off", "-std=c99",
                     "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror", "-Wdouble-promotion",
                     "-I" + str(shadow), "-I" + str(gen),
                     "-c", str(src), "-o", str(obj)])
                objects.append(str(obj))

            exe = out / "audio"
            # pot_packing_audio_test.c includes "dsp/drum909.h" — shadow parent is -I.
            run([cc, "-O2", "-ffp-contract=off",
                 "-I" + str(out / "shadow"), "-I" + str(gen),
                 str(ROOT / "tests/host/pot_packing_audio_test.c"), *objects, "-lm",
                 "-o", str(exe)])
            with (out / "audio.bin").open("wb") as f:
                run([str(exe)], stdout=f)
            data = (out / "audio.bin").read_bytes()
            results[kind] = {"bytes": len(data), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}

            if kind == "packed":
                dump = out / "dump_tanh.c"
                dump.write_text(
                    "#define X0X_DRUM_TABLES_DEFINE\n"
                    "#include \"x0x_drum_tables.h\"\n"
                    "#include <stdio.h>\n"
                    "#include <string.h>\n"
                    "int main(void) {\n"
                    "  for (unsigned i = 0; i < (unsigned)X0X_TANH_N + 2u; ++i) {\n"
                    "    float f = x0x_tanh_value(i);\n"
                    "    unsigned u; memcpy(&u, &f, 4);\n"
                    "    if (fwrite(&u, 4, 1, stdout) != 1) return 1;\n"
                    "  }\n"
                    "  return 0;\n"
                    "}\n"
                )
                dump_exe = out / "dump_tanh"
                run([cc, "-O2", "-std=c99", "-Wall", "-Werror",
                     "-I" + str(gen), str(dump), "-o", str(dump_exe)])
                c_bits = subprocess.check_output([str(dump_exe)], cwd=ROOT)
                expect = b"".join(struct.pack("<I", bits32(v)) for v in tab)
                if c_bits != expect:
                    print("C accessor bits != Python float table", file=sys.stderr)
                    return 1

        assert results["baseline"] == results["packed"], results
        print(json.dumps({
            "status": "PASS_BIT_IDENTICAL_STEREO_AUDIO",
            "base": BASE,
            "tanh_raw_b": raw_b,
            "tanh_packed_b": packed_b,
            "tanh_save_b": save_b,
            "scope": "every 909 and FX parameter, values -1..128, 16 stereo samples per setter; "
                     "plus every tanh table index bit-identical via x0x_tanh_value",
            "results": results,
        }, indent=2))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

                     self.runner/'gate_flashmap.py', self.runner/'validation_inputs.py', self.runner/'pre-push.hook'):

            identity.validate(baseline, self.capture())
        self.config['models'].pop()

        self.assertNotEqual(baseline['sha256'], self.capture()['sha256'])
        self.config['configs']['rel'] = 0

            self.refs, self.pins, env=self.env, runner_dir=self.runner, execution=runtime)

        self.config['worker'] = {'image': 'sha256:first'}
        first = self.capture()
        self.config['worker']['image'] = 'sha256:second'
        self.assertNotEqual(first['sha256'], self.capture()['sha256'])

            X0X_REF_PINS=self.pins, X0X_GATE_INNER='1')
        baseline = self.capture()
        tree = __import__('hashlib').sha1(self.git(self.repo, 'ls-tree', '-r', '--full-tree', 'HEAD').encode()).hexdigest()
        results = self.root/'results'; results.mkdir()
        record = results/(tree+'.md')
        def gate(*extra):
            return subprocess.run(['bash', str(self.runner/'gate.sh'), 'HEAD', '--purpose',
                'owner-validation', '--reason', 'Scratch routing regression', *extra], env=self.env,
                capture_output=True, text=True)

            record.write_text('Result: PASS\n- Config CRCs: fixture'+suffix+'\n')
            result = gate()
            self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stdout+result.stderr)
            self.assertNotIn('result used again', result.stdout)
        record.write_text('Result: PASS\n- Config CRCs: fixture\n- Validation inputs: '+baseline['sha256']+'\n')
        logs = self.root/'logs'; logs.mkdir()

        (logs/'validation-inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps(baseline))

        self.assertIn('result used again', result.stdout)

            result = gate(*extra)

            self.assertNotIn('result used again', result.stdout)
        (self.sdk/'library').write_text('changed SDK')

class PackageBytes(unittest.TestCase):

        self.root = Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.meta = self.root/'fixture.egg-info'
        self.meta.mkdir()
        (self.meta/'PKG-INFO').write_text('Name: fixture\nVersion: 1.0\n')
        (self.meta/'top_level.txt').write_text('fixture\n')
        self.pkg = self.root/'fixture'

        (self.pkg/'__init__.py').write_text('source = 1\n')
        (self.pkg/'native.so').write_bytes(b'binary fixture')
        self.dist = importlib.metadata.Distribution.at(self.meta)

    def runtime(self):
        def distribution(name):
            if name == 'fixture':
                return self.dist
            raise importlib.metadata.PackageNotFoundError(name)
        with patch.object(identity.importlib.metadata, 'distribution', side_effect=distribution):
            return identity.runtime({}, {'X0X_VALIDATION_PYTHON_PACKAGES': 'fixture'})

    def test_distro_source_binary_and_added_file_mutations(self):

        baseline = self.runtime()

        self.assertNotEqual(baseline['python_packages']['fixture']['sha256'], identity.digest(identity.encoded({})))
        for path in (self.pkg/'__init__.py', self.pkg/'native.so', self.pkg/'new.py'):
            with self.subTest(path=path.name):
                original = path.read_bytes() if path.exists() else None
                path.write_bytes(b'changed bytes')
                self.assertNotEqual(baseline, self.runtime())
                if original is None:
                    path.unlink()
                else:
                    path.write_bytes(original)
                self.assertEqual(baseline, self.runtime())
        cache = self.pkg/'__pycache__'
        cache.mkdir(); (cache/'output.pyc').write_bytes(b'output')
        (self.pkg/'output.pyo').write_bytes(b'output')
        self.assertEqual(baseline, self.runtime())

    def test_empty_manifest_uses_installed_modules(self):

            self.assertIn('fixture/native.so', identity.package_files(self.dist))

        script.unlink()
        with self.assertRaises(OSError):
            identity.package_files(dist)

        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.runtime()
        (self.meta/'RECORD').write_text('fixture/output.pyc,,\n')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.runtime()

    def test_optional_absent_packages_remain_explicit(self):
        with patch.object(identity.importlib.metadata, 'distribution', side_effect=importlib.metadata.PackageNotFoundError):
            actual = identity.runtime({}, {'X0X_VALIDATION_PYTHON_PACKAGES': 'optional'})
        self.assertEqual(actual['python_packages'], {'numpy': None, 'optional': None, 'pillow': None})


class ContentWalk(unittest.TestCase):
    @staticmethod
    def original(path, ancestors=(), exclude=()):
        # Frozen pre-repair algorithm, to check the optimized traversal's contract.
        path = Path(path)
        actual = path.resolve(strict=True)
        if actual in ancestors:
            raise ValueError('dependency symlink cycle: ' + str(path))
        if path.is_file():
            return {'sha256': identity.file_hash(path), 'executable': bool(path.stat().st_mode & 0o111)}
        if not path.is_dir():
            raise ValueError('not a dependency file/directory: ' + str(path))
        return {'sha256': identity.digest(identity.encoded({p.name: ContentWalk.original(p, (*ancestors, actual), exclude)
                for p in sorted(path.iterdir()) if p.name not in ('.git', '__pycache__', *exclude)}))}

    def test_original_identity_and_rejections(self):
        parent = TOP/'build/input-fixtures'
        parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=parent) as tmp:
            root = Path(tmp)/'input'; root.mkdir()
            def equal(path=root, exclude=()):
                self.assertEqual(self.original(path, exclude=exclude), identity.content(path, exclude=exclude))
            equal()
            leaf = root/'leaf'; leaf.write_bytes(b'input'); equal(); equal(leaf)
            initial = identity.content(root)
            leaf.chmod(0o755); equal(); self.assertNotEqual(initial, identity.content(root))
            leaf.write_bytes(b'changed'); equal()
            sub = root/'nested'; sub.mkdir(); (sub/'data').write_bytes(b'bytes'); equal()
            (root/'alias').symlink_to(sub, target_is_directory=True); equal()
            (root/'file-alias').symlink_to(leaf); equal()
            # Exclusions apply at every depth, even to dangling links.
            for directory in (root, sub):
                for name in ('.git', '__pycache__', 'ignored'):
                    (directory/name).symlink_to(root/'absent')
            equal(exclude=('ignored',))
            alias = Path(tmp)/'root-alias'; alias.symlink_to(root, target_is_directory=True)
            equal(alias, ('ignored',))
            (sub/'cycle').symlink_to(root, target_is_directory=True)
            for function in (self.original, identity.content):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'symlink cycle'):
                    function(root, exclude=('ignored',))
            (sub/'cycle').unlink()
            (root/'dangling').symlink_to(root/'absent')
            for function in (self.original, identity.content):
                with self.assertRaises(FileNotFoundError):
                    function(root, exclude=('ignored',))
            (root/'dangling').unlink()
            os.mkfifo(root/'unsupported')
            for function in (self.original, identity.content):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'not a dependency'):
                    function(root, exclude=('ignored',))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

#   - a refs-oscuro commit is <commit> or an ancestor of it: the tip of the branch refs-oscuro (if the repository has it)

# Read only. GITDIR default: X0X_REPO, else /workspace/x0x37.git.

case "${1:-}" in --repo) REPO=${2:-}; shift 2 || true;; esac
C=${1:-}
[ -n "$C" ] || { echo "TREE ERROR: usage: release_tree_check.sh [--repo GITDIR] <commit>"; exit 2; }
g() { git -C "$REPO" "$@"; }
H=$(g rev-parse --verify --quiet "$C^{commit}") || { echo "TREE ERROR: no commit $C in $REPO"; exit 2; }

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""PAD_MAP.md "Physical pad placement" against the firmware pad map (the doc and the code must not drift).

Three tables (2 rows x 8, top view): the hardware pad index, the LED chain slot (PADLED_SLOT in
firmware/src/lcd.c) and the mux address (SMK_PADMUX in firmware/hal/smk_input.h; mux A = top row, mux B =
bottom row). The index table must be 0-7 on the top row and 8-15 on the bottom row, left to right: the order
that the step grid (SMK_PAD_OF_WHITE with smk_pad_grid = 1) and the orientation rule (smk_padcal_phys with
tl = 0) use. The status line must be ASSUMED or CONFIRMED (with a date and a build hash)."""
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
doc = (ROOT / "PAD_MAP.md").read_text()
lcd = (ROOT / "firmware/src/lcd.c").read_text()
inp = (ROOT / "firmware/hal/smk_input.h").read_text()
cal = (ROOT / "firmware/src/app/smk_padcal.h").read_text()
fails = 0


def check(ok, what):
    global fails
    print(f"{'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} {what}")
    fails += not ok


def table(tag):
    m = re.search(r"<!-- pad-placement:" + tag + r" -->\n```\n(.*?)```", doc, re.S)
    if not m:
        return None
    return [[int(x) for x in row.strip("|").split("|")] for row in m.group(1).splitlines() if row.startswith("|")]


def carray(src, name):
    m = re.search(name + r"\[[^\]]*\] = \{([^}]*)\}", src)
    return [int(x) for x in m.group(1).split(",")]


sec = doc.split("## Physical pad placement", 1)
check(len(sec) == 2, "PAD_MAP.md has the section \"Physical pad placement\"")
st = re.search(r"^Status: (ASSUMED|CONFIRMED)\b(.*)$", sec[-1], re.M)
check(bool(st) and (st.group(1) == "ASSUMED" or re.search(r"\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d", st.group(2))
                    and re.search(r"[0-9a-f]{8}", st.group(2))),
      "status: ASSUMED, or CONFIRMED with a date and a build hash")

idx, led, mux = table("index"), table("led-slot"), table("mux-address")
check(idx == [list(range(8)), list(range(8, 16))], f"index table: 0-7 top row, 8-15 bottom row ({idx})")
check("smk_pad_grid ? (w)" in inp and "(i ^ tl) & 15u" in cal,
      "firmware: the step grid puts white key w on pad w, the orientation rule is i XOR tl")
slot = carray(lcd, "PADLED_SLOT")
check(led is not None and len(slot) == 16 and all(led[p >> 3][p & 7] == slot[idx[p >> 3][p & 7]] for p in range(16)),
      f"LED slot table = PADLED_SLOT {slot}")
pm = carray(inp, "SMK_PADMUX")
addr = [pm.index(p & 7) for p in range(16)]
check(mux is not None and all(mux[p >> 3][p & 7] == addr[idx[p >> 3][p & 7]] for p in range(16)),
      f"mux address table = SMK_PADMUX {pm} (pad p at the address a with SMK_PADMUX[a] = p mod 8)")
if fails:
    print(f"pad_placement_doc_test: {fails} FAIL")
    sys.exit(1)
print("pad_placement_doc_test: ok")

"""Sample helpers shared by gen_samples.py (built-in sets), fm1_sample_upload.py
(user slots) and tests/pitch.py.

A Felucca web-editor JS port of read_any_wav / resample / ima_encode / user_slot
once lived in web/editor.html and was checked byte-for-byte by web/test_web.mjs.
That editor was retired with the X0X fork (commit 23775375); those checks are gone.
tools/fm1_sample_upload.py remains the reference slot builder.

The float arithmetic here is part of the generated output: keep the order of
operations (and Python's sum() where it is used) when touching these functions.
"""
import math
import re
import struct
import sys
import zlib
from functools import reduce
from operator import add, sub

IMA_STEP = [7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 16, 17, 19, 21, 23, 25, 28, 31, 34, 37, 41, 45, 50, 55, 60, 66, 73, 80, 88,
            97, 107, 118, 130, 143, 157, 173, 190, 209, 230, 253, 279, 307, 337, 371, 408, 449, 494, 544, 598, 658,
            724, 796, 876, 963, 1060, 1166, 1282, 1411, 1552, 1707, 1878, 2066, 2272, 2499, 2749, 3024, 3327, 3660,
            4026, 4428, 4871, 5358, 5894, 6484, 7132, 7845, 8630, 9493, 10442, 11487, 12635, 13899, 15289, 16818,
            18500, 20350, 22385, 24623, 27086, 29794, 32767]
IMA_IDX = [-1, -1, -1, -1, 2, 4, 6, 8]


def wav_chunks(d):
    """RIFF/WAVE chunks -> {id: (offset of the body, declared length)}; the first of each id wins"""
    if len(d) < 12 or d[:4] != b"RIFF" or d[8:12] != b"WAVE":
        raise ValueError("not a WAV file")
    out, i = {}, 12
    while i + 8 <= len(d):
        cid, n = d[i:i + 4], struct.unpack_from("<I", d, i + 4)[0]
        out.setdefault(cid, (i + 8, n))
        i += 8 + n + (n & 1)
    return out


def wav_format(d, ch):
    """-> (tag, channels, rate, bits); validate supported WAVE extensible GUID."""
    if b"fmt " not in ch:
        raise ValueError("WAV without a fmt chunk")
    offset, length = ch[b"fmt "]
    if length < 16 or offset + length > len(d):
        raise ValueError("WAV fmt chunk truncated or invalid")
    tag, channels, rate = struct.unpack_from("<HHI", d, offset)
    align, bits = struct.unpack_from("<HH", d, offset + 12)
    if tag == 0xFFFE:
        if length < 40:
            raise ValueError("WAV extensible fmt chunk truncated")
        extension_size, valid_bits = struct.unpack_from("<HH", d, offset + 16)
        if extension_size < 22 or length < 18 + extension_size:
            raise ValueError("WAV extensible fmt extension length invalid")
        if not 0 < valid_bits <= bits:
            raise ValueError("WAV extensible fmt valid bits invalid")
        guid = d[offset + 24:offset + 40]
        if guid[2:] != bytes.fromhex("000000001000800000aa00389b71"):
            raise ValueError("WAV extensible subtype GUID unsupported")
        tag = struct.unpack_from("<H", guid)[0]
    if channels == 0 or rate == 0 or not (
        (tag == 1 and bits in (8, 16, 24, 32)) or
        (tag == 3 and bits in (32, 64))
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            f"unsupported WAV format (tag {tag}, {bits} bit, "
            f"channels {channels}, rate {rate})"
        )
    if align != channels * (bits // 8):
        raise ValueError("WAV fmt block alignment inconsistent with channels and bits")
    return tag, channels, rate, bits

def read_wav(path):
    """16-bit PCM, first channel, as ints -> (rate, samples, (loop start, loop end) from 'smpl' or None)"""
    d = path.read_bytes()
    ch = wav_chunks(d)
    tag, nch, sr, bits = wav_format(d, ch)
    if bits != 16:
        raise ValueError(f"{path}: {bits}-bit, expected 16")
    o, n = ch.get(b"data", (0, 0))
    s = list(struct.unpack_from("<%dh" % (min(n, len(d) - o) // 2), d, o))[::nch]
    loop = None
    if b"smpl" in ch:
        o = ch[b"smpl"][0]
        if struct.unpack_from("<I", d, o + 28)[0]:          # number of loops
            loop = struct.unpack_from("<II", d, o + 36 + 8)
    return sr, s, loop


def _channel_values(tag, bps, raw):
    """interleaved sample values as floats in [-1, 1)"""
    n = len(raw) // bps
    if tag == 3:
        values = struct.unpack("<%d%s" % (n, "f" if bps == 4 else "d"), raw)
        if not all(math.isfinite(v) for v in values):
            raise ValueError("WAV float data contains a NaN or infinity sample")
        return list(values)
    if bps == 2:
        return [v / 32768 for v in struct.unpack("<%dh" % n, raw)]
    if bps == 3:                                     # 24 bit: pad to 32 (zero low byte), exact power-of-two scale
        w = bytearray(4 * n)
        w[1::4], w[2::4], w[3::4] = raw[0::3], raw[1::3], raw[2::3]
        return [v / 2147483648 for v in struct.unpack("<%di" % n, w)]
    if bps == 4:
        return [v / 2147483648 for v in struct.unpack("<%di" % n, raw)]
    return [(b - 128) / 128 for b in raw]


def read_any_wav(path):
    """PCM 8/16/24/32 or float, any channel count, mixed to mono -> (rate, [float]).
    A truncated data chunk is fine."""
    d = path.read_bytes()
    ch = wav_chunks(d)
    tag, nch, sr, bits = wav_format(d, ch)
    bps = bits // 8
    if tag not in (1, 3) or not bps or not nch:
        raise ValueError(f"{path}: unsupported WAV format (tag {tag}, {bits} bit)")
    o, n = ch.get(b"data", (0, 0))
    frame = bps * nch
    nfr = min(n, len(d) - o) // frame
    v = _channel_values(tag, bps, d[o:o + nfr * frame])
    if nch == 1:
        return sr, v
    if nch == 2:                                     # (0.0 + l + r) / 2, as the per-channel sum below
        mixed = [(a + b) / 2 for a, b in zip(v[0::2], v[1::2])]
        if not all(math.isfinite(value) for value in mixed):
            raise ValueError("WAV channel mix overflowed into NaN or infinity")
        return sr, mixed
    out = []
    for f in range(0, len(v), nch):
        acc = 0.0
        for c in range(nch):
            acc += v[f + c]
        out.append(acc / nch)
    if not all(math.isfinite(value) for value in out):
        raise ValueError("WAV channel mix overflowed into NaN or infinity")
    return sr, out


def resample(x, sr, to):
    """crude anti-alias (moving average over the ratio), then linear interpolation"""
    if sr == to:
        return x
    if sr > to:
        k = max(1, int(round(sr / to)))
        if k == 2:
            x = [(a + b) / 2 for a, b in zip(x, x[1:])] + [x[-1] / 2] if x else []
        elif k > 1:                                  # left to right like the editor (not sum(): compensated
            x = [reduce(add, x[i:i + k]) / k for i in range(len(x))]   # since Python 3.12)
    step, out, p, last = sr / to, [], 0.0, len(x) - 1
    append = out.append
    while p < last:
        i = int(p)
        f = p - i
        append(x[i] * (1 - f) + x[i + 1] * f)
        p += step
    if not all(math.isfinite(value) for value in out):
        raise ValueError("WAV resampling overflowed into NaN or infinity")
    return out


def _diff_py(w, W, hi):
    """d[tau] = sum((w[i] - w[i + tau]) ** 2 for i in range(W)), tau = 1..hi+1"""
    head, two = w[:W], [2] * W
    return [0.0] + [sum(map(pow, map(sub, head, w[tau:tau + W]), two)) for tau in range(1, hi + 2)]


def _diff_np(w, W, hi):
    """_diff_py with numpy, all lags at once. Python >= 3.12 sums floats with Neumaier
    compensation (Objects/bltinmodule.c builtin_sum); this runs the same steps in the same
    order per lag, so the results are the same doubles."""
    a = np.asarray(w, dtype=np.float64)
    taus = np.arange(1, hi + 2)
    f = (a[0] - a[taus]) ** 2                      # sum() starts at int 0: 0 + x == x for x >= 0
    c = np.zeros_like(f)
    for i in range(1, W):
        x = (a[i] - a[i + taus]) ** 2
        t = f + x
        c += np.where(np.abs(f) >= np.abs(x), (f - t) + x, (x - t) + f)
        f = t
    f = np.where(c != 0, f + c, f)
    return [0.0] + f.tolist()


try:
    import numpy as np
    if sys.version_info < (3, 12):               # plain left-to-right sum() there
        raise ImportError
    _diff = _diff_np
except ImportError:
    _diff = _diff_py


def yin(w, sr, fmax=2000, fmin=30, threshold=0.15, interpolate=True):
    """YIN (cumulative-mean-normalised difference) over the window w: the first dip under
    the threshold between the periods of fmax and fmin, else the deepest -> Hz"""
    W = len(w) // 2
    lo, hi = max(2, int(sr / fmax)), min(W - 1, int(sr / fmin))
    d = _diff(w, W, hi)
    cm, run = [1.0] * (hi + 2), 0.0
    for tau in range(1, hi + 2):
        run += d[tau]
        cm[tau] = d[tau] * tau / run if run else 1.0
    tau = next((t for t in range(lo, hi) if cm[t] < threshold and cm[t] <= cm[t + 1]), None)
    if tau is None:
        tau = min(range(lo, hi), key=lambda t: cm[t])
    if interpolate and 1 <= tau < hi:
        y0, y1, y2 = cm[tau - 1], cm[tau], cm[tau + 1]
        den = y0 - 2 * y1 + y2
        tau = tau + (0.5 * (y0 - y2) / den if den else 0)
    return sr / tau


def detect_hz(x, sr):
    """pitch of a recording: YIN on 3000 samples from 0.15 s in (or the last 3000)"""
    a = int(0.15 * sr)
    return yin(x[a:a + 3000] if len(x) > a + 3000 else x[-3000:], sr)


def hz_to_midi(hz):
    return 12 * math.log2(hz / 440.0) + 69


def peak(x, floor=1e-9):
    return max(floor, max(map(abs, x)))


def onset(x, rel=0.02):
    """index of the first sample above rel x peak"""
    thr = rel * peak(x)
    return next((i for i, v in enumerate(x) if abs(v) > thr), 0)


def trim_silence(x, sr, floor=0.001, pre_ms=1, fade_ms=5):
    """cut the silence at both ends of mono floats (full scale 1.0): keep pre_ms (whole ms) before the
    first sample above floor (0.001 = -60 dBFS), keep fade_ms after the last one and fade that tail
    to 0 (linear; the last fade_ms of the sound if the file ends there). All silent (or empty): x
    unchanged. web/x0x_breaks.js trimSilence gives the same floats: keep the order of operations."""
    loud = [i for i, v in enumerate(x) if abs(v) > floor]
    if not loud:
        return x
    pre, nf = sr * pre_ms // 1000, sr * fade_ms // 1000
    a, b = max(0, loud[0] - pre), min(len(x), loud[-1] + 1 + nf)
    y = list(x[a:b])
    m = min(nf, len(y))
    for j in range(m):
        k = len(y) - m + j
        y[k] = y[k] * ((m - 1 - j) / m)
    return y


def ima_encode(samples, loop_start):
    """IMA ADPCM, 4 bit, low nibble first, from predictor 0 / index 0
    -> (bytes, (predictor, index) at loop_start)"""
    pred, idx, nib, state_at_loop = 0, 0, bytearray(), (0, 0)
    steps, adj = IMA_STEP, IMA_IDX
    for n, x in enumerate(samples):
        if n == loop_start:
            state_at_loop = (pred, idx)
        step = steps[idx]
        diff = x - pred
        code = 0
        if diff < 0:
            code = 8
            diff = -diff
        vd = step >> 3
        if diff >= step:
            code |= 4
            diff -= step
            vd += step
        if diff >= step >> 1:
            code |= 2
            diff -= step >> 1
            vd += step >> 1
        if diff >= step >> 2:
            code |= 1
            vd += step >> 2
        pred = pred - vd if code & 8 else pred + vd
        if pred > 32767:
            pred = 32767
        elif pred < -32768:
            pred = -32768
        idx += adj[code & 7]
        if idx < 0:
            idx = 0
        elif idx > 88:
            idx = 88
        nib.append(code)
    if len(nib) & 1:
        nib.append(0)
    return bytes(a | (b << 4) for a, b in zip(nib[0::2], nib[1::2])), state_at_loop


def key_split(roots):
    """sorted root notes -> [(lo, hi)]: each zone reaches halfway to its neighbours, the
    outer zones to the ends of the keyboard"""
    n = len(roots)
    return [(0 if j == 0 else (roots[j - 1] + r) // 2 + 1, 127 if j == n - 1 else (r + roots[j + 1]) // 2)
            for j, r in enumerate(roots)]


# ---- user sample slots (firmware/src/eng_sample.c, web/EDITOR_PROTOCOL.md)
SLOT_SIZE, SLOT_DATA_OFF, SLOT_RATE, SLOT_ZONES = 0x14000, 512, 22050, 16
SLOT_HDR_LEN = 32 + SLOT_ZONES * 28
SLOT_MAX_DATA = SLOT_SIZE - SLOT_DATA_OFF
OLDSCHOOL_FACTOR = 2
MIN_LOOP_SAMPLES = 64
OLDSCHOOL_GRIT = {"light": 1.5, "medium": 2, "heavy": 3, "max": 4.0}


def parse_oldschool_grit(arg):
    """--oldschool-grit name or numeric factor; invalid values raise ValueError."""
    if arg in OLDSCHOOL_GRIT:
        return OLDSCHOOL_GRIT[arg]
    f = float(arg)
    if f <= 1 or f > 8:
        raise ValueError("oldschool grit factor must be > 1 and <= 8")
    return f


def note_from_name(name, default=60):
    """"C4" / "F#3" / "Bb2" in a file name, C4 = 60 (as the web editor), clamped to 0..127"""
    m = re.search(r"(?<![A-Za-z])([A-G])([#b]?)(-?\d)(?!\d)", name)
    if not m:
        return default
    pc = "C D EF G A B".index(m.group(1)) + {"#": 1, "b": -1, "": 0}[m.group(2)]
    return max(0, min(127, (int(m.group(3)) + 1) * 12 + pc))


def to_int16(x):
    """mono float -> int16 list, peak normalised to 30000"""
    pk = peak(x)
    return [max(-32768, min(32767, int(v / pk * 30000))) for v in x]


def apply_oldschool(samples, storage_rate, factor=OLDSCHOOL_FACTOR):
    """Speed up by `factor`, return (samples, playback_rate) for the slot zone header."""
    if factor <= 1:
        return samples, storage_rate
    x = [s / 32768.0 for s in samples]
    y = resample(x, storage_rate, storage_rate / factor)
    out = to_int16([v * 0.95 for v in y])
    playback = int(round(storage_rate / factor))
    if len(out) < MIN_LOOP_SAMPLES:
        raise ValueError(f"too short after oldschool processing ({len(out)} samples)")
    return out, playback


def user_slot(name, zones, rate=SLOT_RATE, slot_size=SLOT_SIZE):
    """zones: [(int16 samples at `rate`, root, lo or None, hi or None)] -> (header bytes, ADPCM data).
    Zones without lo/hi split the keyboard between their roots. rate: 22050 or 44100 (the header
    stores it per zone, the firmware reads it). slot_size: the device's slot size (SMP_INFO)."""
    max_data = slot_size - SLOT_DATA_OFF
    zs, data = [], bytearray()
    for s, root, lo, hi in zones:
        adp, st = ima_encode(s, 0)
        zs.append(dict(off=len(data), n=len(s), ls=0, le=len(s) - 1, root=root, lo=lo, hi=hi, pred=st[0], idx=st[1]))
        data += adp
    if len(data) > max_data:
        raise ValueError(f"too long: {len(data)} B of ADPCM, a slot holds {max_data} B "
                         f"({max_data * 2 / rate:.1f} s in all)")
    if not 1 <= len(zs) <= SLOT_ZONES:
        raise ValueError(f"1..{SLOT_ZONES} files per slot")
    zs.sort(key=lambda z: z["root"])
    for z, (lo, hi) in zip(zs, key_split([z["root"] for z in zs])):
        if z["lo"] is None:
            z["lo"], z["hi"] = lo, hi
    q16 = int(round(rate / 44100 * 65536))
    zb = b"".join(struct.pack("<5I2h4B", z["off"], z["n"], z["ls"], z["le"], q16, z["root"] * 16, z["pred"],
                              z["idx"], z["lo"], z["hi"], 0) for z in zs)
    nm = re.sub(r"[^\x20-\x7E]", "", name.upper())[:8].encode().ljust(8, b"\0")
    hdr = struct.pack("<IHBB8sII8x", 0x504D5346, 1, len(zs), 0, nm, len(data), zlib.crc32(data)) + zb
    return hdr.ljust(SLOT_HDR_LEN, b"\0"), bytes(data)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""SMP_BEGIN / mid-WRITE cancel must not wipe the last good sample.

Cancel = BEGIN with no WRITE/END: header stays. Mid-WRITE that erased sector 0
restores it from the FL_SMPV shadow on the next BEGIN (or failed END).
A full BEGIN→WRITE→END rewrite still replaces the slot.
"""
import struct
import sys
import zlib
from pathlib import Path

SRC = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(SRC / "tools"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(SRC / "tests"))
import x0x_slots as xs  # noqa: E402
from slot_mock import MockDevice  # noqa: E402

FAILS = 0


def check(cond, what):
    global FAILS
    print(f"  {'ok  ' if cond else 'FAIL'} {what}")
    FAILS += not cond


def img(name=b"GOODLOOP", nsamp=128, rate=22050):
    data_len = (nsamp + 1) // 2
    data = bytes((i * 17) & 0xFF for i in range(data_len))
    hdr = bytearray(xs.HDR_LEN)
    struct.pack_into("<IHBB8sII", hdr, 0, xs.MAGIC, 1, 1, 0, name, data_len,
                     zlib.crc32(data) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    struct.pack_into("<5I", hdr, 32, 0, nsamp, 0, 0, int(round(rate * 65536 / 44100)))
    return bytes(hdr) + bytes(xs.DATA_OFF - xs.HDR_LEN) + data


def header_name(dev, k):
    o = dev.slots[k][0]
    h = xs.parse_header(bytes(dev.fl.mem[o:o + xs.HDR_LEN]))
    return None if not h else h["name"]


def main():
    b = img()
    d = MockDevice(count=2, size=0x14000)
    k = 0
    assert d.req(xs.CMD_BEGIN, [k])[1] == 0
    for off in range(xs.DATA_OFF, len(b), 256):
        a = [k, off & 0x7F, (off >> 7) & 0x7F, (off >> 14) & 0x7F] + xs.pack7(b[off:off + 256])
        assert d.req(xs.CMD_WRITE, a)[-1] == 0
    assert d.req(xs.CMD_END, [k] + xs.pack7(b[:xs.HDR_LEN]))[1] == 0
    check(d.nz[k] == 1 and header_name(d, k) == "GOODLOOP", "setup: last-good sample present")

    before = bytes(d.fl.mem[d.slots[k][0]:d.slots[k][0] + len(b)])
    assert d.req(xs.CMD_BEGIN, [k])[1] == 0
    check(d.nz[k] == 1 and header_name(d, k) == "GOODLOOP",
          "BEGIN alone keeps nz and name (cancel / abandon)")
    check(bytes(d.fl.mem[d.slots[k][0]:d.slots[k][0] + len(b)]) == before,
          "BEGIN alone leaves flash bytes unchanged")

    # BEGIN then END with no WRITE must refuse (NOR cannot rewrite a live header).
    b_rename = img(name=b"NEWNAME1")
    assert d.req(xs.CMD_BEGIN, [k])[1] == 0
    check(d.req(xs.CMD_END, [k] + xs.pack7(b_rename[:xs.HDR_LEN]))[1] == 6,
          "END without WRITE -> rc 6 (no sector-0 erase)")
    check(d.nz[k] == 1 and header_name(d, k) == "GOODLOOP",
          "refused END keeps last-good name")
    check(bytes(d.fl.mem[d.slots[k][0]:d.slots[k][0] + len(b)]) == before,
          "refused END leaves flash bytes unchanged")

    # One WRITE erases sector 0; abandon then BEGIN must restore last-good.
    assert d.req(xs.CMD_BEGIN, [k])[1] == 0
    off = xs.DATA_OFF
    a = [k, off & 0x7F, (off >> 7) & 0x7F, (off >> 14) & 0x7F] + xs.pack7(b[off:off + 256])
    assert d.req(xs.CMD_WRITE, a)[-1] == 0
    check(d.nz[k] == 0 and header_name(d, k) is None, "first WRITE clears live header")
    assert d.req(xs.CMD_BEGIN, [k])[1] == 0
    check(d.nz[k] == 1 and header_name(d, k) == "GOODLOOP",
          "BEGIN after mid-WRITE abandon restores last-good")
    check(bytes(d.fl.mem[d.slots[k][0]:d.slots[k][0] + len(b)]) == before,
          "restored sector 0 matches pre-import bytes")

    # Bad END after a corrupting WRITE restores last-good too.
    assert d.req(xs.CMD_BEGIN, [k])[1] == 0
    a = [k, off & 0x7F, (off >> 7) & 0x7F, (off >> 14) & 0x7F] + xs.pack7(bytes([0xAA] * 256))
    assert d.req(xs.CMD_WRITE, a)[-1] == 0
    check(d.req(xs.CMD_END, [k] + xs.pack7(b[:xs.HDR_LEN]))[1] == 3, "END CRC mismatch -> rc 3")
    check(d.nz[k] == 1 and header_name(d, k) == "GOODLOOP",
          "failed END restores last-good from shadow")

    # Without BEGIN, a populated slot still refuses WRITE.
    d2 = MockDevice(count=2, size=0x14000)
    d2.load(0, b[:xs.HDR_LEN], b[xs.DATA_OFF:])
    off = xs.DATA_OFF
    a = [0, off & 0x7F, (off >> 7) & 0x7F, (off >> 14) & 0x7F] + xs.pack7(b[off:off + 256])
    check(d2.req(xs.CMD_WRITE, a)[-1] == 4, "WRITE without BEGIN on occupied slot -> rc 4")

    # Full rewrite after BEGIN still works and replaces the sample.
    b2 = img(name=b"NEWLOOP1", nsamp=64)
    assert d.req(xs.CMD_BEGIN, [k])[1] == 0
    for off in range(xs.DATA_OFF, len(b2), 256):
        a = [k, off & 0x7F, (off >> 7) & 0x7F, (off >> 14) & 0x7F] + xs.pack7(b2[off:off + 256])
        assert d.req(xs.CMD_WRITE, a)[-1] == 0
    assert d.req(xs.CMD_END, [k] + xs.pack7(b2[:xs.HDR_LEN]))[1] == 0
    check(d.nz[k] == 1 and header_name(d, k) == "NEWLOOP1", "BEGIN+WRITE+END replaces sample")

    # Multi-sector sample: WRITE past 0x1000 then abandon must fail closed
    # (empty slot), not restore a sector-0 header over wiped higher data.
    data_len = 5000
    big = img(name=b"BIGLOOP1", nsamp=data_len * 2)
    assert xs.DATA_OFF + data_len > 0x1000
    d3 = MockDevice(count=2, size=0x14000)
    d3.load(0, big[:xs.HDR_LEN], big[xs.DATA_OFF:])
    base = d3.slots[0][0]
    sec1_before = bytes(d3.fl.mem[base + 0x1000:base + 0x2000])
    check(d3.nz[0] == 1, "setup: multi-sector last-good present")
    assert d3.req(xs.CMD_BEGIN, [0])[1] == 0
    for off in range(xs.DATA_OFF, 0x1000 + 256, 256):
        a = [0, off & 0x7F, (off >> 7) & 0x7F, (off >> 14) & 0x7F] + xs.pack7(bytes([0xA5]) * 256)
        assert d3.req(xs.CMD_WRITE, a)[-1] == 0
    check(bytes(d3.fl.mem[base + 0x1000:base + 0x2000]) != sec1_before,
          "WRITE at 0x1000 destroys higher-sector last-good")
    assert d3.req(xs.CMD_BEGIN, [0])[1] == 0
    d3.scan(0)
    check(d3.nz[0] == 0, "abandon after higher-sector WRITE leaves slot empty (fail-closed)")
    check(not d3._backup_present(0), "higher-sector erase cleared sec0 shadow")

    # Higher-sector WRITE first (no prior sector-0 erase): header must not survive.
    d4 = MockDevice(count=2, size=0x14000)
    d4.load(0, big[:xs.HDR_LEN], big[xs.DATA_OFF:])
    assert d4.req(xs.CMD_BEGIN, [0])[1] == 0
    off = 0x1000
    a = [0, off & 0x7F, (off >> 7) & 0x7F, (off >> 14) & 0x7F] + xs.pack7(bytes([0x5A]) * 256)
    assert d4.req(xs.CMD_WRITE, a)[-1] == 0
    check(header_name(d4, 0) is None, "higher-first WRITE wipes live sector-0 header")
    check(d4.nz[0] == 0 and not d4._backup_present(0),
          "higher-first WRITE leaves no restore shadow")

    print("x0x slots begin-cancel: all ok" if not FAILS else "X0X SLOTS BEGIN-CANCEL FAILED")
    return 1 if FAILS else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""Measure the factory mix against a big-beat reference (Chemical Brothers, Fatboy Slim): a funk
break up front, a 909 kick under it, clap on 2 and 4, open hats on the off-beats, a 303 line.
Played through the simulator with the factory sound, rendered whole and part by part (the 909
voice by voice), then each render's loudness, peak, crest and tonal balance.

  tools/mix_report.py [OUTDIR]          (default build/mix; needs build/host/x0x_host)

The break is a real one, for measuring only: build/breaks/ (tools/import_breaks.py from BB Gen's
samples) loaded into user slot 1 as the simulator would after tools/upload_breaks.py. Without
those files the built-in 909 loop plays instead. The 808 plays the same groove for its own solo.
303 A plays its factory TB-3PO line (303 B its own, solo only). Default tempo.

Loudness is ITU-R BS.1770 (K-weighted, ungated over the loop): LU, comparable between the
renders. Peaks are against the codec's full scale (the output is limited at -6 dBFS, Felucca's
ceiling). Crest = peak - RMS: a squashed big-beat mix sits near 8-10 dB. Bands are the share of
the render's energy, in dB."""
import subprocess
import sys
import wave
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from scipy import signal

SRC = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
HOST = SRC / "build" / "host" / "x0x_host"
FS = 44100
PARTS = ["909", "808", "303A", "303B", "BREAK"]


def white(ws):
    return [f"tapkey w{w}" for w in ws]


def voice(b, steps):                  # select drum track b, toggle its steps
    return [f"tapkey b{b}"] + white(steps)


BREAKS = [SRC / "build" / "breaks" / f"{n}.wav" for n in ("THINK", "FUNKY")]


def groove_909(voices=None):
    v = {"BD": voice(0, [0, 4, 8, 12]), "CP": voice(6, [4, 12]), "OH": voice(8, [2, 6, 10, 14])}
    out = []
    for k in (voices or v):
        out += v[k]
    return out + ["press ENV"] + white([0, 8]) + ["release ENV"]


def groove_808():
    return (["turn ALGO 1"] + voice(0, [0, 4, 8, 12]) + voice(6, [4, 12]) + voice(10, [0, 4, 8, 12])
            + voice(9, [2, 6, 10, 14]) + voice(7, [3, 11]) + ["turn ALGO -1"])


def break_on():
    s = ["turn ALGO 4"] + white(range(16))
    if all(b.exists() for b in BREAKS):               # the real breaks: loops A and B
        s += ["turn SELECT 3", "turn K1 2", "turn K2 2", "turn SELECT -3"]
    return s + ["turn ALGO -4"]


def script(wav, voices=None, play=("909", "303A", "BREAK"), bars=8, raw=False):
    s = ["wait 300"]
    if raw:                           # the balance before the master: its compressor and PUMP off
        s += ["param 6 0 1 0", "param 6 0 6 0"]
    if all(b.exists() for b in BREAKS):
        s.append("slot 0 BRK " + " ".join(str(b) for b in BREAKS))
    s += groove_909(voices) + groove_808() + break_on() + ["tap HOME"]
    for i, p in enumerate(PARTS):     # every part not playing: muted on HOME
        if p not in play:
            s.append(f"tapkey b{i}")
    ms = int(60000 / 125 * 4)
    s += ["tap PLAY", f"wait {ms}", f"wav {wav}", f"wait {ms * bars}", "wavstop", "tap PLAY"]
    return "\n".join(s) + "\n"


def k_weight(x):
    """BS.1770 K-weighting at 44.1 kHz (the two biquads, from their analogue prototypes)."""
    import math
    f0, G, Q = 1681.974450955533, 3.999843853973347, 0.7071752369554196
    K = math.tan(math.pi * f0 / FS)
    Vh, Vb = 10 ** (G / 20), 10 ** (G / 20) ** 0.4996667741545416
    a0 = 1 + K / Q + K * K
    b1 = [(Vh + Vb * K / Q + K * K) / a0, 2 * (K * K - Vh) / a0, (Vh - Vb * K / Q + K * K) / a0]
    a1 = [1, 2 * (K * K - 1) / a0, (1 - K / Q + K * K) / a0]
    f0, Q = 38.13547087602444, 0.5003270373238773
    K = math.tan(math.pi * f0 / FS)
    a2 = [1, 2 * (K * K - 1) / (1 + K / Q + K * K), (1 - K / Q + K * K) / (1 + K / Q + K * K)]
    b2 = [1, -2, 1]
    return signal.lfilter(b2, a2, signal.lfilter(b1, a1, x))


def analyse(path):
    with wave.open(str(path)) as w:
        x = np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()), dtype=np.int16).astype(np.float64)
        x = np.asarray(x.reshape(-1, w.getnchannels())[:, 0]) / 32768.0
    if not len(x) or not np.any(x):
        return None
    lu = -0.691 + 10 * np.log10(np.mean(k_weight(x) ** 2) + 1e-20)
    peak = 20 * np.log10(np.max(np.abs(x)) + 1e-20)
    rms = 20 * np.log10(np.sqrt(np.mean(x ** 2)) + 1e-20)
    f, p = signal.welch(x, FS, nperseg=8192)
    tot = np.sum(p)
    bands = {}
    for name, lo, hi in (("sub", 20, 60), ("bass", 60, 200), ("lowmid", 200, 800), ("mid", 800, 3000),
                         ("high", 3000, 8000), ("air", 8000, 20000)):
        m = (f >= lo) & (f < hi)
        bands[name] = 10 * np.log10(np.sum(p[m]) / tot + 1e-20)
    return {"lu": lu, "peak": peak, "rms": rms, "crest": peak - rms, "bands": bands}


def main():
    out = Path(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else SRC / "build" / "mix"
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    jobs = {"MIX": dict(), "MIX + 808, 303B": dict(play=PARTS), "MIX, raw": dict(raw=True),
            "BREAK": dict(play=("BREAK",), raw=True), "909": dict(play=("909",), raw=True),
            "303A": dict(play=("303A",), raw=True), "303B": dict(play=("303B",), raw=True),
            "808": dict(play=("808",), raw=True)}
    for v in ("BD", "CP", "OH"):
        jobs[f"909 {v}"] = dict(play=("909",), voices=[v], raw=True)
    res = {}
    for name, kw in jobs.items():
        tag = name.replace(" ", "_").replace("+", "").replace(",", "")
        wav = out / f"{tag}.wav"
        sc = out / f"{tag}.x0x"
        sc.write_text(script(wav.name, **kw))
        r = subprocess.run([str(HOST), str(sc), str(out)], capture_output=True, text=True)
        if r.returncode:
            print(r.stdout[-2000:])
            raise SystemExit(f"{name}: the simulator failed")
        res[name] = analyse(wav)
    ref = res["MIX, raw"]["lu"]
    print("the parts are measured before the master's compressor ('raw'): vs MIX is against the raw mix")
    print(f"{'render':16} {'LU':>7} {'vs MIX':>6} {'peak':>6} {'crest':>6}   bands: sub bass lowmid mid high air (dB of the total)")
    for name, a in res.items():
        if not a:
            print(f"{name:16} silent")
            continue
        b = " ".join(f"{a['bands'][k]:5.1f}" for k in ("sub", "bass", "lowmid", "mid", "high", "air"))
        print(f"{name:16} {a['lu']:7.1f} {a['lu'] - ref:+6.1f} {a['peak']:6.1f} {a['crest']:6.1f}   {b}")
    print(f"renders in {out}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
